description: fz has no is_number/1: a call reports lower/unbound. Kernel gains it beside is_integer/is_float (an integer clause, a float clause, a false clause), in the prelude import list and the moduledoc; Macro.escape's first clause tests it.
title: is_number/1 answers whether a value is an integer or a float, in bodies and guards, as in Elixir
